hero.heading: Hi, I’m
hero.introduction: I created Good Paws Rescue because I believe every animal deserves kindness, care, and a chance to find a loving home.

image.alt: Two happy dogs spending time together outdoors

mission.heading: Every animal deserves to be met with
paragraphs: I believe every animal deserves to feel safe, cared for, and loved. A difficult beginning should never decide the rest of their story.
That belief is what inspired me to create Good Paws: a place built around second chances and finding animals a home where they belong.
